title: The Hoax of the Twentieth Century
author: Arthur Butz
current_text: In 1984, RCMP officers seized The Hoax of the Twentieth Century from the library of the University of Calgary under the Customs Tariff Act; it was classified as “hate literature,” but was returned to the university’s library shelves because customs officers had prohibited it after it entered the country. In 1995, the RCMP seized a copy of The Hoax of the Twentieth Century from a public library in Didsbury (AB), and it was shredded before the librarian could respond because the RCMP said it was prohibited.
